messages:
Casey: Clearing desk before relocation 1 LANES move. Free 27\" 1440p monitor (IPS), minor scratch on back, includes DP cable. Also have 2 GA festival wristbands (Saturday) if anyone wants 'em. Pickup from SF lounge by Thu noon. Pics: https://imgur.com/xx123 :sunglasses:
Noah: Interested in monitor. VESA?
Casey: Yep VESA 100. No dead pixels.
Riley: I want a wristband! Can you transfer the ticket?
Casey: Yep e-ticket transfer works. First person to DM gets band 1, second gets band 2.
Asha: If monitor's still available after lunch I can pick up. Otherwise I can grab a wristband if any left.
Noah: Quick Q 1 does it support 75Hz/FreeSync?
Casey: 75Hz max, no adaptive sync. Good for coding and light gaming.
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: label personal items placed in common areas. Unclaimed items will be moved to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Riley: DM sent for ticket 1. Thanks Casey! :raised_hands:
Noah: DM'd for monitor. If I don't get it, shout and I can still take a wristband.
Asha: If Noah takes monitor, I'll take band 2. Otherwise I'll grab monitor Mon morning.
Casey: Noted. I'll label monitor "CASEY - CLAIMED" while we sort transfers. Leaving cables taped to the leg of the lounge table.
Riley: Transfer complete for band 1. See you Sat! :tada:
Noah: Confirmed pickup Mon 9am for monitor. Thanks!
Casey: Cool. I'll update here if anything changes. If anyone else wants the monitor stand (detachable) it's available for $10 1 plants fund.
